picks.editorial_note: A $1.5 billion NSF initiative adding a dedicated AI-for-physical-systems funding track signals a major, sustained federal bet on AI research infrastructure at national scale.
picks.title: NSF announces 3 additional topics as part of the NSF X-Labs initiative to pursue generational breakthrough science and technology efforts

picks.editorial_note: A $15 million gift from the OpenAI Foundation to build open pharmacokinetic datasets could meaningfully accelerate AI-driven drug development across the whole field, not just one lab.
picks.title: A Gift to Help Scientists Predict How Drugs Behave in the Body

picks.editorial_note: NSF's ELEGANT program ties AI-relevant semiconductor research directly to U.S. manufacturing competitiveness, reflecting a deliberate policy push to secure the domestic microelectronics supply chain underpinning AI hardware.
picks.title: NSF invests in translating low-dimensional semiconductor technologies to establish U.S. leadership in microelectronics

picks.editorial_note: A $26.5 million ARPA-H award for an AI 'co-pilot' aimed at rural medical care is a concrete example of AI addressing a real healthcare access gap, with national reach via Reuters coverage.
picks.title: Reuters covers SRI's work in the ARPA-H-funded PARADIGM program - SRI

picks.editorial_note: Unifying protein sequence and structure into a single language model is a genuine scientific advance that could reshape how researchers map evolutionary and functional relationships across the protein universe.
picks.title: Uniting sequence and structure to map the protein universe | Science Tokyo

picks.editorial_note: UCLA's hardware-as-neural-network approach to 'physical AI' points toward fundamentally more energy-efficient computing architectures, a breakthrough direction rather than an incremental application.
picks.title: Toward physical AI: When the hardware becomes the neural network

picks.editorial_note: Integrating EPFL's open-source Apertus model into Proton's Lumo assistant puts academically-developed AI in front of tens of millions of privacy-conscious users, a rare case of university research reaching mass consumer scale.
picks.title: Apertus partners with Proton's Lumo AI assistant

picks.editorial_note: Rutgers' Innovation Hub with RWJBarnabas Health and AWS pairs a major cloud provider with an academic medical system, the kind of industry-clinical alliance likely to shape how AI reaches patient care.
picks.title: Rutgers and RWJBarnabas Health to Launch Innovation Hub, Powered by Amazon Web Services

picks.editorial_note: DARPA's new prize competition for autonomous trauma surgical robotics pushes AI toward high-stakes, life-or-death clinical autonomy, a notable expansion of real-world AI applications in medicine.
picks.title: $3.5M to advance autonomous trauma robotics

picks.editorial_note: Applying AI to reason over decades of nuclear waste safety data, backed by DOE's Genesis Mission, shows AI being trusted with a high-consequence regulatory and public-safety task.
picks.title: AI project reviews nuclear waste safety-case evidence
